# 💳 Firecrawl Dashboard Reporting

💳 Requires a Firecrawl API key — the hosted service is paid (usage-based credits). Curated by Skill Harbor — a dashboard-reporting workflow: give it an authenticated dashboard you have legitimate access to, and it extracts the visible metrics into a dated report with the reporting period, units and explicit caveats about what was captured. By @firecrawl, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: it reads only what the dashboard shows through your own authenticated session — if the session expires, re-authenticate; never bypass access controls, and confirm you have the right to extract and share the metrics before doing so. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
